summary: First-finish smoke test of Green Solutions app. Backend auth (/api/auth/login, /me, register duplicate 400), /api/contact, and /api/portfolio/metrics (Bearer-protected) all pass. Frontend: landing renders both vertical sidebar (data-testid=app-sidebar) and horizontal topbar (data-testid=app-topbar); hero headline matches. Contact form submits and shows success toast. /dashboard correctly redirects unauthenticated users to /login. Login with admin creds succeeds and redirects to /dashboard where all 4 KPI cards (kpi-portfolio-health, kpi-ai-findings, kpi-ai-confidence, kpi-energy-24h) plus AI Priority Findings list render with real backend metrics. Bad credentials show inline login-error 'Invalid email or password'. Logout clears gs_token from localStorage.
passed: GET /api/auth/me with Bearer returns user object
GET /api/portfolio/metrics with Bearer returns KPIs and findings
POST /api/auth/register duplicate email returns 400 'Email already registered'
Landing page shows sidebar + topbar + hero 'Make every renewable asset more intelligent.'
Sidebar Contact link navigates to /contact and form submits with success toast
Login flow logs in admin, redirects to /dashboard, renders 4 KPI cards with real metrics and AI Priority Findings
Bad credentials show login-error 'Invalid email or password'
Logout via topbar-logout-btn removes gs_token from localStorage
notes: Initial run showed 0 KPI cards due to querying before metrics fetch completed; retest with wait_for_selector confirmed all 4 KPI cards render correctly. No app-code issues.
